capabilities: Send notes from chosen folders to an Asyntai knowledge base
Update, rename or delete knowledge base entries as notes change
Ask the website chatbot questions inside Obsidian
Insert chatbot answers into the current note
Read website chats and leads and save chats as notes
disambiguation: Not a general AI assistant for your vault; it mainly syncs notes to an Asyntai website chatbot and reads its chats.
extras: Notes shorter than 120 characters are skipped; front matter is removed and Markdown is converted to plain text. At startup it only adds or updates, so removals require Send all.
problem: Website chatbot content and visitor conversations live outside Obsidian, so notes must be copied manually and chats are not available while writing.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks to the Asyntai API at asyntai.com

summary: Connector that sends vault notes to an Asyntai website chatbot knowledge base and reads website chats and leads.
